clubs.name: MMA Colombo Combat Club
clubs.description: MMA Colombo Combat Club offers MMA, boxing, kickboxing, Muay Thai and fitness training in Colombo and Wattala, Sri Lanka. View venues and contact the coaching team.
clubs.trainingInformation: Led by Master N.S. Kumara, MMA Colombo welcomes children, youth and adults, including beginners and experienced students. Training combines martial arts fundamentals, fitness, conditioning and self-defence, with support for recreational students and developing fighters. Contact the coaching team for the current schedule, the right class for your age and goals, and what to bring to your first session.

clubs.name: International Japan Karate-Do Youshin Dojo
clubs.description: International Japan Karate-Do Youshin Dojo teaches full-contact karate, kickboxing, MMA and grappling in Delgoda, Gampaha, Sri Lanka.
